Use case: ui-mockup. Asset: FINAL high-fidelity visual screen design for a landscape MOBILE GAME "War of Words", later to be recreated in Godot. Create ONE screen only: BATTLE. Full bleed flat screen image, exact 2:1 landscape aspect ratio, target 1920x960. No phone frame, no collage, no annotations outside screen.
Input image role: world/character reference ONLY. Retain adult short-dark-haired female explorer in teal coat/orange scarf with brass energy gauntlet and bronze violet-core automaton. Recompose to fit the UI, do not stretch the reference.
Art direction across a six-screen set: polished illustrated adventure for adults as well as teens, bright sunlit sandstone ruins, sky blue, restrained navy enamel UI with warm brushed-brass rims, cream lettering, tangible elegant game controls, confident bold readable typography. No chibi or childish mascots. Not a website, no dashboard panels, no tiny copy. All important text at least 36px at this image resolution, large 100px+ touch controls.
Layout: TOP 34% is side-view duel, full-body heroine far left and computer sentinel far right, clear space between them. Their health bars across top, player label "YOU" with "100/100"; enemy "SENTINEL" with "76/100" and small "CPU"; large central pause icon. Fighters entirely within this upper arena, feet on its bottom floor.
BOTTOM 66% is a tactile word board with exactly 28 big circular tiles in 7 columns by 4 rows, occupying central width 48%. Row letters EXACTLY: row1 S T O N E S T; row2 R E A M L I N; row3 E P L A N E T; row4 C A R D S E N. Large dark uppercase letters, clear spacing, cream-tinted gold, pale blue, pale violet and pale mint tile families. Small discrete symbol per tile (bolt, diamond, wave, plus) accompanies color. A luminous connecting line connects only first five adjacent tiles S T O N E, with readable letters remaining. Immediately above grid selected word "STONE" in a compact brass-edged rail. Do not overlay text on board.
Two BIG vertically stacked ability buttons at left of board: gold energy blaster icon "PULSE" / "READY", blue shield icon "AEGIS" / "4/6". Two at right: violet electrical coil "ARC" / "3/8", mint medical injector "MEND" / "2/6". Each is a finished illustrated game ability badge with a clear charge ring. Lower right one smaller snowflake powerup control "×1". No stat tables, no paragraph instructions, no web navigation. Composed specifically for thumbs, strong hierarchy and legibility at phone size. Make it look like a professionally art-directed finished mobile action-puzzle game UI. Original artwork, no Slugterra branding or assets.

Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE final high-fidelity MOBILE GAME screen, flat full-bleed landscape, exact 2:1 ratio, target 1920x960. No device frame, no montage, no outside annotations. Input image is the STYLE REFERENCE for the SAME game, "War of Words". Match its original adult female explorer, sunlit sandstone ruins, blue sky, rich illustrated adventure art, dark navy enamel with restrained warm brass edge trim, cream bold readable lettering, tactile large rounded buttons, readable elegant serif headings. Audience includes adults, no chibi/mascots. This is a game, not website/dashboard. All functional labels LARGE, minimum 36px at target resolution, primary buttons 100px+ high, generous thumb hit areas, short English text only. SAME blue shield, gold energy blast, violet electrical coil, mint healing injector icon language. Avoid tiny descriptions, dense stats, repeated navigation, ads, purchases, clutter. Keep critical elements inset 80px horizontally, 40px vertically.
SCREEN: MAIN MENU. A beautiful immersive opening screen. Background: sunlit ruined observatory in a vast sandstone canyon, sky and distant floating towers. Adult short-dark-haired heroine wearing teal expedition coat and orange scarf occupies left third, shown full body, holding a compact brass energy gauntlet. Right half generous readable space. Upper right a small solid gold coin icon with "480" and a 100px circular settings cog. Large game logo in center-right: "WAR OF" on line 1, "WORDS" on line 2, elegant bold dimensional ivory and brass lettering, composed as a polished game title. Below logo a small chapter label "SUNWARD RUINS". Below, a single very prominent warm gold button "PLAY" with right arrow. Along bottom right under Play, two equal large navy-brass buttons, each with an original substantial illustrated icon above label: "ARSENAL" energy-gauntlet icon and "UPGRADES" gear icon. Only these three destination buttons. Cinematic but playable-looking, uncluttered, appealing to adults. No letter board, no battle HUD, no tagline paragraphs.
